title: 'Something in the Reed-Cuts' paid out and marked done for killing a fen-eel in its den, even though the eel-trader herself said afterward the fen-eel 'wasn't what's tearing my traps -- different bite, different drag,' leaving it unclear whether the actual culprit was ever addressed.
